services.name: Backend API
services.features: REST API for clothing products, size/color variants, inventory, orders, administrative authentication, validated image uploads, SQLite persistence and health checks.

services.name: Storefront and Admin UI
services.features: Public clothing catalog, product search/filtering, cart and order submission, plus an authenticated administrative dashboard for products, variants, stock, images and order status.
